messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: SLA breach for customer 'Saffron Health' (tenant_id=saff-42). Condition: embed-error-rate > 5% over 5m. Affected routes: /v1/embeddings (hosted-dedicated). Link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/2256789012
Maya (oncall): acked, I'm on it. pinging SREs.
Maya (oncall): first glance: spike correlates with high concurrent sessions from saff-42, looks like timeouts + 5xx.
Maya (oncall): @Jun can you pull 5m/15m QPS and 95p latency for saff-42 and global for last 30m? also check KV-cache hitrate.
Jun (sre): on it, give me ~2m.
Jun (sre): Kibana query I'm running:```service:inference AND tenant_id:saff-42 AND timestamp:now-30m..now | stats p95(latency), sum(errors), avg(kv_cache_hit) by 1m```
Jun (sre): results: p95 latency jumped to 1.9s at 22:07 UTC (baseline ~0.3s), errors (5xx) rose to ~7% for saff-42, KV hitrate dropped from 86% -> 46% during spike.
Alex (runtime): sounds like prefix caching thrash from large prompt churn. saff-42 has many cold sessions. Could be causing long tail latency and evictions.
Priya (platform): I can spin a variant with warmed cache on ded-4 to take some load. Low-risk canary.
Maya (oncall): mitigation plan (short):
- temp silence noisy pager for saff-42 (so we don't flood pages while we act)
- route saff-42 traffic to warmed canary on ded-4 (Priya)
- change alert to per-tenant rate threshold + 3m debounce to avoid repeat pages
- post-incident: create tenant-centric dashboard + runbook entry
Maya (oncall): executing step 1: `/silence-alert --id 2256789012 --scope tenant:saff-42 --duration 30m --reason "live mitigation"`
OpsBot: Command accepted. Silence created: s-sil-225678 (expires in 30m). :white_check_mark:
Jun (sre): while silenced, we should reduce global alert aggressiveness. Suggest changing evaluation window from 5m->10m and require errors > 5% AND absolute error count > 20 in window.
Alex (runtime): Agreed. Also propose adding a debounce per-tenant: must be sustained for 3 consecutive windows before paging. That'll cut noise for chatty customers.
Maya (oncall): I can push an ad-hoc alert patch now. Draft config snippet:```alert: saffron-embed-error
scope: tenant_id == "saff-42"
window: 10m
conditions:
  - errors_ratio > 0.05
  - errors_count > 20
debounce: 3
severity: warning
```
Priya (platform): ded-4 canary up in ~3m. I'll attach a warm cache job: `python tools/warm_cache.py --tenant saff-42 --targets ded-4 --concurrency 4`
Priya (platform): started warm job. warming logs:```[22:12:10] queued 120 keys
[22:13:05] warmed 87 keys (72%)
[22:14:30] warmed 120 keys (100%)```
Jun (sre): metrics after routing to canary (22:15 UTC): saff-42 p95 dropped to 420ms, errors down to 1.8%, KV hit up to 81%.
Maya (oncall): nice. keeping silence active for now to avoid noise while we validate.
Alex (runtime): quick config change deployed to routing: `route tenant:saff-42 -> ded-4-canary (weight=1.0)`. Rolling change applied.
Maya (oncall): creating minimal tenant dashboard for Saffron Health: link -> https://redwood.internal/dashboards/saff-42-temp (includes QPS, p95, errors, kv_hit).
Maya (oncall): immediate ask: @Jun can you create a short-lived alert that triggers only if post-routing errors > 3% for 15m so we can be notified if canary degrades?
Jun (sre): creating now. Using evaluation: window 15m, threshold 0.03, min_count 10.
Maya (oncall): good. status check in 20m, if stable we'll extend changes and write runbook.
Priya (platform): note: saff-42 traffic volume is bursty every ~12-15m due to batch customer job. We should consider smoothing their scheduler or request advising them.
Maya (oncall): I'll ask CS to check with Saffron ops: `@CS-team FYI: we're mitigating a repeated embed error spike tied to your scheduled batch jobs, can we sync?`
Alex (runtime): follow-up permanent fix ideas: 1) per-tenant cache reservation 2) adaptive batching cap 3) model variant fallback for heavy bursts. Need to estimate cost/impact.
Jun (sre): post-mitigation metrics (22:35 UTC): p95 350-500ms, errors ~1.2%, KV hit ~84%. Looks healthy.
Maya (oncall): lifting silence early at 22:37 to let tuned alerts evaluate (silence id s-sil-225678). `/unsilence s-sil-225678`
OpsBot: Unsilence accepted. Silence s-sil-225678 removed.
Maya (oncall): alerts now running on updated thresholds. If we see re-trigger we escalate.
Priya (platform): creating ticket for platform work: "tenant-cache-reservations and debounce-defaults" assigned to eng-runtime. ETA: 2 sprints. ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PLAT-4921
Alex (runtime): I'll own the runtime ticket for adaptive batching proof-of-concept. Adding notes to ticket.
Maya (oncall): Postmortem quick notes: cause = tenant-induced cache churn from scheduled batch load -> long-tail latency -> alert noise. Mitigation = warmed canary routing + alert debounce + thresholded alerting.
Maya (oncall): follow-ups: 1) permanent per-tenant dashboard + SLA guardrails, 2) runbook for tenant-caused spikes, 3) contact Saffron ops to coordinate scheduling and potential rate limits.
Jun (sre): adding short-term dashboard to observability collection and tagging it saff-42 incident-225678.
Maya (oncall): anyone else? otherwise closing thread in 30m unless additional pages. :white_check_mark:
Priya (platform): thumbs up. will update ticket and link postmortem once done.
Alex (runtime): thanks team.
Maya (oncall): closing handover to platform/runtime for follow-ups.
incident-bot: Incident auto-log: 2256789012 recorded. Severity: P2. Duration: ~25m. Linked ticket: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2256789012
Maya (oncall): thread archived into incident tracker and runbook tasks created.
